text_zh: 铅屑够了就别买了，会烫手
text_en: Stop buying shavings when full, burns

text_zh: 左边那个遗物，D-0388试过，手指没了
text_en: Left relic - D-0388 tried, lost fingers

text_zh: 圣印别乱搭配，会互相咬
text_en: Don't mix sigils, they bite each other

text_zh: 又涨价了？昨天还是12铅币的
text_en: Price up again? Was 12 coins yesterday

text_zh: 谁用了我的笔？还我！- D-0205
text_en: Who took my pen? Give back! - D-0205

text_zh: 这破地方连个椅子都没有
text_en: This dump doesn't even have chairs

text_zh: D-0144说熔蜡遗物别碰，会做噩梦
text_en: D-0144 says don't touch wax relics, nightmares

text_zh: D-0299借走3个铅币，下次见面还
text_en: D-0299 borrowed 3 coins, pay back next time

text_zh: 昨晚又听到敲字声了，明明没人在
text_en: Heard typing again last night, nobody there

text_zh: 记得在表单上签名，不然找不到你
text_en: Remember to sign forms, or they can't find you
